instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, eye-level. Inside a karate dojo with yellow walls, red and blue floor mats, and wall-mounted swords, two martial artists practice self-defense. On the left, the man in the black uniform with white stripes (R1) faces right, throwing a high right-hand strike. On the right, the woman in the black uniform with a red belt (R2) stands facing left, raising her left forearm overhead to block his strike. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the vibrant mats.
elements: R1 throws a high right-hand strike toward R2
R2 raises her left forearm overhead to block R1's strike
R1 is the attacker while R2 is the defender/blocker in the self-defense drill
